name: Seaworthy Outrigger Catamaran
description: A dual-hulled ocean catamaran equipped with lateen sail rigging, stabilized keel rudder, and sealed provisions.

hull.name: Reinforced Keel & Hull
hull.description: Waterproofed cedar timber lashed with natural pitch.

rigging.name: Canvas Sail & Rigging
rigging.description: Marine-grade cordage and woven canvas for open-ocean steering.

rudder.name: Stabilizer Keel & Rudder
rudder.description: Hardened hardwood and metal-reinforced steering assembly.

provisions.name: Sealed Survival Provisions
provisions.description: Water casks and salted/dried rations for 10 days at sea.
